description: USD value of a wallet on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism: native ETH plus major tokens (USDC and WETH everywhere, the common Base tokens on Base) and up to 20 tokens you add, each priced from its deepest Uniswap v3 pool, read live from the chain. Returns holdings, total and anything that could not be priced. Not a full token inventory. Use to check what a wallet is worth before trading, lending or paying. Price $0.005/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

chain.description: Network: base (default), eth, arb or op

tokens.description: Optional extra comma-separated 0x token addresses (up to 20)
